PLAN "12-Week Postpartum Return (Cesarean-Safe)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "gentle recovery to full-body strength"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Weeks 1-2 (Light only, C-section safe)" (2 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 25m "Gentle Mobility + Walk":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          arm_circles 2x10 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
          wrist_circles 2x10 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
          neck_roll 2x5 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          cat_cow 3x6 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog 3x6 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          glute_bridge 2x8 rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 2x10 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 25m "Gentle Mobility + Walk":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:

          cat_cow 3x6 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
